role: Documentation annotations supplement actual installed-app O1 observations; they never replace them.

annotations.rule: Blank lines separate paragraphs; adjacent extra blank space collapses in Reading view.
One Enter creates a physical source line that is normally a semantic continuation in rendered output; Strict line breaks is a relevant recorded setting.
Two trailing spaces or Shift+Enter create a hard line break; HTML br is also documented for explicit spacing.
One through six leading hash characters create H1 through H6.
Asterisk and underscore emphasis variants, double-tilde strike, and backslash escapes are documented.
A leading greater-than marker creates quoted text.
Dash/asterisk/plus unordered markers, dot/right-parenthesis ordered markers, tasks, mixed nesting, and Tab/Shift+Tab indentation are documented.
Inline backticks, backtick or tilde fences, and tab/four-space indented code are documented.
Pipe-delimited tables require a header delimiter row; colon alignment and Live Preview table editing are documented.
Inline and display dollar-delimited math are documented.
Live Preview hides most syntax until the caret enters formatted content; Source mode displays syntax exactly; Reading view presents content without Markdown syntax.
Record Strict line breaks, smart lists, tab-vs-spaces indentation, and tab visual width with every O1 corpus.
Obsidian combines CommonMark, GFM, LaTeX, and Obsidian extensions; unsupported Obsidian-only extensions are not implicitly added to Viewer audit scope.

discrepancyRule: When documentation and the installed runtime differ, retain both, use O1 as the interaction observation, and classify the discrepancy explicitly rather than silently choosing.
